# SanoVault

> SanoVault is a free (beta) personal health record app for Indian families. Each family has a folder where members can upload or scan lab reports, prescriptions, discharge summaries and other medical papers, keep a medicine list for each person, forward files by WhatsApp after linking a number, and create time-limited share links. It is free during the beta; AI extraction and summaries may become paid later.

## Who it is for, and what it is not

SanoVault is for families who want to keep their own medical papers, including older paper reports and files from different hospitals and labs, in one place.

- It is not a hospital system and does not give medical advice.
- It is not a replacement for ABHA. It does not currently fetch records from ABHA or ABDM; you can optionally save an ABHA number on a profile for reference.
- It is available as a web app and an iOS app (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sanovault/id6812724169). There is no Android app yet.
- It is not certified under HIPAA, GDPR or India's DPDP Act.
- It does not promise India-only storage (see the privacy policy).
